profiles.name: Redundant / Routing-Confusable
profiles.definition: Very high structural overlap creates low incremental merge value and high routing confusion.

scenario_signatures.triage: only actionable if source QA is clear

profiles.name: Overlap / Needs Disambiguation
profiles.definition: Moderate overlap supports plausible merge use but routing requires task signal to avoid confusion.

scenario_signatures.triage: review candidate if QA is not weak

profiles.name: Merge-OK / Routing-Separable
profiles.definition: Pair can look merge-acceptable while still being easy for routing separation.

scenario_signatures.merge: can be acceptable under merge lens
scenario_signatures.triage: not necessarily prioritized without quality evidence

profiles.name: QA-Blocked / Structurally Nontrivial
profiles.definition: Structural compatibility is present, but weak-source evidence blocks action.

scenario_signatures.routing: structural separability/confusability secondary to source quality

profiles.name: Same-Family Optional
profiles.definition: Same-family relation justifies cautious optional review, not automatic retention.

scenario_signatures.merge: can perform near same-task in validated examples

profiles.name: Cross-Task Low-Value Control
profiles.definition: Cross-task boundary plus weaker compatibility yields low priority under constrained budgets.

scenario_signatures.triage: caution or exclusion unless strong contrary evidence
